parameters.description: Accepts a triage decision plus email context from P2-01. Creates a reviewable Gmail draft (never auto-send), upserts an idempotent Asana task, and sends an urgent alert only for configured urgent conditions. On Asana failure the draft state is preserved and the task is marked failed + replayable.

nodes.name: Load email_events State
nodes.notes: Loads the existing email_events row to check for an already-populated draft_id/task_id. Task idempotency uses the email Message-ID so reruns cannot duplicate tasks.

nodes.name: Prepare Handoff Plan
nodes.notes: Determines which side effects to create. Review_required items get no draft, task, or alert (the review_queue record from P2-02 holds the draft for human review). Urgent alert only for configured urgent conditions (high importance + client_request/billing). An urgent alert is skipped when email_events already holds an alert_id, so a handoff replay does not alert twice.

nodes.name: Create Gmail Draft
nodes.notes: Creates a reviewable Gmail draft (never auto-send). credentials required after import. Fallback if this Gmail draft operation is unsupported in the n8n version: store the draft text in the review_queue Airtable record instead (still never auto-send). The regular-output error policy means a draft failure does not block the Asana task.

parameters.name: ={{ '[msg:' + ($('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.message_id || $('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.idempotency_key) + '] ' + ($('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.category || 'inbox') + ': ' + ($('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.subject || '(no subject)') }}

otherProperties.notes:
={{ 'Source: ' + ($('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.source_link || 'n/a') + '
Mailbox: ' + $('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.mailbox + '
Correlation ID: ' + $('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.correlation_id + '
Message-ID: ' + $('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.message_id + '
Category: ' + ($('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.category || '') + '
Importance: ' + ($('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.importance || '') + '
Confidence: ' + ($('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.confidence || '') + '

Summary: ' + ($('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.summary || '') + '

Draft reply (review before sending):
' + ($('Prepare Handoff Plan').item.json.draft_reply || '(none)') }}

nodes.name: Create Asana Task
nodes.notes: Upserts an Asana task in project REPLACE-ASANA-PROJECT-ID with source link, summary, mailbox, correlation ID, and due date. Task name includes the Message-ID-derived idempotency key so reruns cannot duplicate tasks. The regular-output error policy means an Asana failure preserves the draft and is handled below.

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(item => ({ json: { ...item.json, alert_sent: false, alert_skipped: true, alert_reason: 'slack_not_configured' } }));

nodes.name: Urgent Alert Adapter — Not Configured
nodes.notes: Slack is an optional add-on and no credential is configured in the portfolio environment. This explicit no-op preserves the urgent-alert branch without making the master workflow invalid.

nodes.name: Capture Handoff Results
nodes.notes: Merges draft_id, task_id, alert_sent, and any errors. Task state is pending → synced only after a verified Asana task ID; failed on Asana API failure. Draft state is preserved independently.

parameters.name: ={{ '[ALERT][CRITICAL] Gmail login failed — reconnect the Gmail credential in n8n' }}

otherProperties.notes:
={{ 'The P2 handoff could not use Gmail because of a login/authorization error. Drafts and urgent alerts will fail for every email until the Gmail credential is reconnected in n8n (Credentials > Gmail > Reconnect).

Error: ' + $('Capture Handoff Results').item.json.gmail_auth_error + '
Failed stage: ' + ($('Capture Handoff Results').item.json.failed_stage || 'gmail') + '
Message-ID: ' + $('Capture Handoff Results').item.json.message_id + '
Correlation ID: ' + $('Capture Handoff Results').item.json.correlation_id + '

After reconnecting, replay the dead-letter row for this message.' }}

nodes.name: Create Gmail Auth Alert Task
nodes.notes: Alerts through Asana, not Gmail, because the Gmail credential is the thing that failed. One task per affected email; repeated tasks mean the login is still broken.

nodes.name: Write Dead Letter
nodes.notes: On Asana API failure: draft state is preserved, task marked failed + replayable (P2-E2E-011). The draft is not erased by the task failure.

nodes.name: Update email_events Handoff State
nodes.notes: Writes draft_id and task_id to email_events only after the handoff returns. task_id is populated only when a verified Asana task ID exists. Also writes alert_id and processing_status (completed/failed), so a successful manual replay leaves the event completed.

nodes.name: Find Pending Dead Letters
nodes.notes: After a successful handoff (for example a manual replay), finds this correlation ID's pending P2 dead-letter rows. Returns nothing when the handoff failed.

nodes.name: Mark Dead Letter Resolved
nodes.notes: Marks the dead-letter row resolved with the replay execution ID.

parameters.jsCode:
const c = $('Capture Handoff Results').first().json;
return [{ json: {
  correlation_id: c.correlation_id,
  message_id: c.message_id,
  email_event_id: c.email_event_id,
  draft_id: c.draft_id,
  task_id: c.task_id,
  task_status: c.task_status,
  task_error_code: c.task_error_code,
  alert_sent: c.alert_sent,
  review_required: c.review_required,
  review_queue_id: c.review_queue_id,
  final_status: c.asana_failed ? 'task_failed_draft_preserved' : 'handoff_complete'
}}];
